title: Unspecified Behavior Record
description: A record of undocumented, contradictory, or ambiguous behavior found during discovery. Domain-neutral: no source or target technology is named in this schema.

$schema.description: Scheme-less relative path from the instance file to its schema file.

schema_version.description: Instance schema version. Major component pinned to the v1 directory; minor and patch are free.

title.description: Short human-readable name of the record.

category.description: The nature of the unspecified behavior.

discovery_context.description: How and where the behavior was discovered.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence Reference id values grounding this record.

identifier.description: Shared identifier grammar. Lowercase alphanumeric start; dots, underscores, and hyphens permitted.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp enforced by regex because the validator runs without a FormatChecker.

metadata.title: Free-form consumer metadata
metadata.description: Sanctioned extension point. Additional properties are permitted here only.
